text: Go to the part you have been tidying around.
Do the thing you scheduled for later, badly, now.
What are you polishing so you don’t have to finish?
Name the task you keep renaming.
The research is done. You knew that a week ago.
Open the file you keep scrolling past.
What would you work on if this one were forbidden?
You are busy. With what, exactly?
Find the dullest reason you stopped.
Start where you last flinched.
Write down the question you hope nobody asks. Answer it.
Who were you when this seemed like a good idea?
Would you make it if no one could know it was yours?
What did you want before you wanted this to be good?
Say why you’re making it. Now say the real reason.
Is this the work, or proof that you work?
What are you trying to be forgiven for?
Name whose career you are borrowing. Give it back.
What score is this settling?
What would be enough?
If it succeeds completely, what changes on Tuesday?
Which part is armour?
Cut the part you are keeping so no one can blame you.
What are you showing off so no one looks closer?
What joke are you making so you don’t have to mean it?
Find the clever line. Write the true one under it.
Put back what you deleted for being too much like you.
What have you made difficult so it can’t be judged?
You are hedging. Pick the side you would lose on.
Fix the flaw you are keeping as an excuse.
What would it cost you to be plain?
Say the sentimental thing without the wink.
Who is reading over your shoulder? Ask them to leave.
Whose approval is this shaped like?
Make it for the one person who would get it.
Cut the part that answers a critic who has not spoken.
Who taught you that this was not allowed?
You are performing difficulty. For whom?
Make the thing your heroes would find embarrassing.
Stop explaining. Who needed the explanation?
Imagine it is found, unsigned, in fifty years.
Show it to the friend you would hide it from.
Do the thing you are waiting to be told you may do.
Nobody is coming to approve this.
You are allowed to want it to be liked.
Suppose you are already good enough. What is the problem now?
Use the obvious idea. No one is keeping score.
Act as if the apprenticeship ended last year.
You may change your mind in public.
Which old promise is still running this?
Finish it at the size you can actually finish.
You are allowed to stop. Do you want to?
